arguments.value: This agreement is between Natalija Tunevic, director of FreeCook, and Mitchell Vitalis, director of Mitchell's Web Advance, PLC. It says that FreeCook will pay Mitchell's Web Advance $5,000 to design and develop a website according to the attached scope of work. Payment is $1,900 upfront and $3,100 when the work is completed. The project term is 12 weeks from February 8, 2018 to May 3, 2018, though delays may happen if the client is late with materials, approvals, or changes. Changes to the scope of work must be agreed to in writing and may increase the price. Client content must be provided in the required electronic format, and the company will not proofread or correct it unless the client pays the hourly rate. The company may use the client’s name, logos, website graphics, and positive feedback for marketing, and may place a credit in the website footer. Rush work outside normal business hours costs the standard hourly rate of $40 plus 25%. The company will provide customer service during normal business hours for hosting-related questions and complaints. The source does not state any governing law.
